description:
Deferred from tuning-applied-ledger-and-validation-status-20260712 (review
finding N10): DataFrame runs record df_tuning_config as a config blob with no
applied/validated/hash concept. Extend the applied-ledger model to the DF
runner: record the runtime settings actually applied (threads, memory limits,
chunk sizes, write_config partition/sort/row-group at write time) as ledger
entries with an applied_ledger_hash, and emit the same validation-status
vocabulary in DF bundles. A heavily thread/memory-tuned polars run becomes
distinguishable from a default run in the bundle and explorer.

deferrals.reason: Pre-existing plumbing gap in benchbox/cli/** (OUT of this item's scope: core/dataframe, platforms/dataframe, core/runner/dataframe_runner, core/results, explorer_pipeline, tests). run.py:1151 resolves df_tuning_config but non-interactive path pops it (run.py:2446) instead of putting it in benchmark_config.options (only interactive does, run.py:2444) -> plain CLI DF run builds an UNTUNED adapter, no ledger. The ledger impl is correct (populates via interactive CLI / runner+adapter API / direct run - all verified). Needs a cli/** fix.
deferrals.summary: Non-interactive 'benchbox run --tuning <file>' does not propagate DataFrame tuning config into the adapter

preserves.behavior: SQL-side ledger semantics unchanged; shared vocabulary reused, not forked

prior_art.concept: benchbox/core/dataframe/tuning/write_config.py: the physical write-layout surface to record
benchbox/core/tuning/applied_ledger.py: the ledger model - reuse, do not fork
